The Zultys Difference

What Makes Us Unique

🛡

Reliability & Redundancy

Our Cloud Services target 99.999% reliability, with multiple redundant data back-up centers monitored 24/7/365. East and west data centers back up every Zultys solution — so customers never have to worry about system failure.

Learn more →
🔒

Security & Compliance

We meet stringent compliance benchmarks across industries — including HITECH, CPNI, Ray Baum, and Kari's Law — and our products are fully HIPAA compliant, so healthcare organizations can meet Covered Entity requirements with confidence.

Learn more →
🤝

Partner-First, Always

A direct line runs from our Partners, Agents, and their customers straight to our engineering team. End-user feedback shapes every advancement, so the features that matter most are always at your fingertips.

Learn more →
